name: Button
purpose: Runs an action, or (asChild) gives a link the look of a button.

props.loading: boolean: spinner, disabled, aria-busy while the action runs
props.asChild: boolean: render the single child (e.g. a router Link) with the button's look

rules: One primary button per page or dialog, for its main action.
Use destructive only for actions that delete, reject or cancel something.
A button with only an icon (size='icon') must have an aria-label.
Labels are short verbs: Save, Submit for approval, Reject. No 'Click here'.
